data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** $(git rev-parse HEAD)
* **affected files:** any source file where an agent adds a REVIEW-DEFENSE inline comment
* **skill:** /dso:fix-bug, /dso:review, resolver sub-agents

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Per REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md R6: agents responding to CI LLM review findings (enforcement.strategy=ci) should use two valid paths:
1. **Fix**: implement a code change and commit — the diff is the defense
2. **Defend**: record the defense via review-defense-store.sh so mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh posts machine-readable DEFENSE_RECORD: {} PR comments before the next CI run

Inline REVIEW-DEFENSE comments in source files are NOT consulted by the CI llm-review job. They do not satisfy the machine-readable defense contract.

#### Actual Behavior

Agents (including the session agent in PR #111) add inline `# REVIEW-DEFENSE (PR #...)` comments to source files when addressing CI LLM review findings in PR-based workflows. These comments:
1. Are not read by the CI llm-review runner in a machine-readable way
2. Do not satisfy the DEFENSE_RECORD contract used by mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh
3. Clutter source files with workflow-state artifacts that should live in the defense store or PR comments

### 3. Action History

* PR #111 fix-bug session: agent added multiple inline REVIEW-DEFENSE comments to merge-to-main-pr.sh and test-merge-to-main-pr.sh when addressing CI llm-review findings, instead of using review-defense-store.sh + mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md Step R6 defines the two valid defense paths
* plugins/dso/scripts/review-defense-store.sh — defense storage backend
* plugins/dso/scripts/mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh — mirrors defenses to PR as DEFENSE_RECORD comments
* Fix sketch: update fix-bug SKILL.md and review resolution prompts to direct agents to use the defense store rather than inline REVIEW-DEFENSE comments in PR-based workflows
data.title: [review-workflow]: agents add inline REVIEW-DEFENSE comments -> outdated mechanism for PR-based workflows
